ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface area with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated at the distal tips and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous field covering the central fluke area; high-contrast white mottling and dense clusters are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, with sparse white pixel clusters along the mid-trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an acute internal angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes; prominent jagged peaks and valleys present across the entire trailing edge, with a deep irregular notch visible on the mid-left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves sweeping upwards and outwards toward sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groups localized on the extreme distal margins of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; prominent diagonal rake marks visible on the lower-left lobe surface and vertical/diagonal scratch clusters on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across both lobes and heavy barnacle-induced calcification/scarring at the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, dense cluster of white circular objects (barnacles) on the leading and distal edges of the fluke tips.
